commit.author: Marcelo Araya-Salas <marcelo.araya@ucr.ac.cr>
commit.message:
Fix invisible maps in geographic variation vignette

out.height = "100%" on the leaflet widgets resolved to 0px because no
ancestor element in the plain html_document layout declares an
explicit height, so percentage heights had nothing to resolve
against. Use a fixed pixel height instead.
